response.sql: SELECT per_rental.store_id, AVG(per_rental.total_amount) AS avg_payment_total_per_rental, AVG(per_rental.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) AS per_rental GROUP BY per_rental.store_id ORDER BY per_rental.store_id
